# Sidedoor Digital

> Sidedoor Digital is a one person digital build studio based in Southport, Merseyside, run by Jordan. Custom websites, apps, POS systems, e-commerce, booking systems, QR ordering, automations and custom software for small businesses across Southport, Preston, Liverpool and Birkenhead.

Sidedoor Digital builds one project at a time, start to finish, with no account managers, no junior handed the work, and no agency mark up. Pricing is a one off build fee plus a low monthly fee for hosting and upkeep.

## What we build

- Websites: custom builds coded from scratch, not page builder templates
- Apps: web and mobile ready, for loyalty, bookings and galleries
- POS systems: till, stock and staff working together
- E-commerce: checkout, stock and delivery handled properly
- Booking and scheduling: staff calendars, deposits, automatic reminders
- QR ordering: QR menus, loyalty cards, check ins
- Automations: emails, stock alerts, follow ups handled quietly in the background
- Integrations: getting existing tools to talk to each other
- AI search: search that understands what people mean
- Custom software: dashboards, internal tools, member systems

## Who we build for

Small businesses that want something built around how they actually work: salons, cafes, restaurants, home schools, shops, tradespeople and anyone starting a business online.

## Where

Based in Southport, Merseyside. Client work across Southport, Preston, Liverpool and Birkenhead, with remote projects taken on anywhere in the UK.
